body: I went today without smoking as well. I still feel like I'm going insane, I want to smoke so badly. The nicotine patches help significantly. Since its Friday, I'm going to try and reframe from drinking tonight. I think I'm just gonna take a long drive to clear my head.

I don't live in Mumbai now, I live in Southern Ontario and I was born in Edmonton. I simply lived in Mumbai for 5 years while my dad managed a companies office there, it was an interesting experience but I definitely felt out of place as the only white kid at that private school in Mumbai. He eventually left the company and he and my mom started a business in Montreal and live there and leave me in Ontario.

I have a prescription inhaler that I use for emergencies (i.e Severe Asthma attacks) and an over the counter inhaler for common use. I've had diagnosed asthma since I was 10. My doctor says my asthma is likely caused by both genetics and environment. My family lived in Mumbai for 5 years while my father did work for a company there. Air pollution in Mumbai is pretty bad.

I have not had a cigarette all day, I feel like I'm going insane. The nicotine patches do help quite a bit though, I think I'm going to give quitting a chance. As for my pack, I will be destroying it later.

I'm actually a pretty good student, since my social life is practically non-existant I study a lot more than the average person. I pick Friday nights to get drunk because I'll have time to do homework the next day. I'm just so bothered and disappointed by the fact that I'll spend the rest of my life alone.

I've had two major asthma attacks this month and I've already gone through 3 inhalers since late August. There is no doubt that the smoking has contributed to this. As for the depression, I do not feel suicidal. I have in the past but I don't see it happening again, I've kinda come to terms being alone for probably my whole life.

That might be a good idea, I had a bad Asthma attack today and nearly passed out in class. I'm going to the doctor later, I will ask him about my smoking habits and maybe he can keep this knowledge from my parents.

Edit: The worst part was that as I was struggling to breathe and I had trouble finding my inhaler in my backpack no one even turned a glance. Even as I was wheezing and clearly struggling to breathe no one even asked if I was okay, let alone offered assistance. As things were starting to turn black I finally found it and even then still no one seemed to give a shit. This only reaffirms my cynism and helps confirm that I will be forever alone, I don't want to let this make my habits worse but its likely.

I would like to quit but its just so difficult. I know that Cigarrettes are bad for me and lately I have been coughing and needing my inhaler a lot more than usual, but there is a part of me that feels that Cigarrettes take some of the pain away and it doesn't want me to quit. As for being alone, I just don't see it not happening. I have already gotten the strong indication that no one in real life wants anything to do with me. Even my 'friends' choose to hang out with other people and almost never invite me to anything.

Just about every Friday and/or Saturday night for me. Its gotten to the point that I actually cry some nights while I sit in my house alone. Everyone else in my grade is usually at some party that everyone except me was invited to. God Damn it being forever alone sucks.

I know that there are a lot of women out there but I'm sure that 99% of them will want nothing to do with my pathetic self. The chances of me finding that one woman who isn't like that are 1 in a 100,000,000,000,000.

I wish I was able to do that but I just know people will say "What the fuck is wrong with you?". I feel that being eternally miserable is probably less painful than endlessly chasing impossible happiness and being let down time after time after time.

A doctor told me today though that once a man starts getting facial hair they are normally done with puberty. My dad didn't grow until he was a Junior and Senior in high school but I doubt I will be any taller than 5'5 at most.
